_note: Expected layout and columns of the raw datasets. If your files differ, edit this file (not the scripts) and re-run inspect_datasets.py.

lumos5g.citation: A. Narayanan et al., Lumos5G: Mapping and Predicting Commercial mmWave 5G Throughput, ACM IMC 2020

irish5g.citation: D. Raca et al., Beyond Throughput, The Next Generation: A 5G Dataset with Channel and Context Metrics, ACM MMSys 2020

puffer.citation: F. Y. Yan et al., Learning in situ: a randomized experiment in video streaming, USENIX NSDI 2020
puffer.only_for: re-running scripts/data/calibrate_content.py; the calibrated data/processed/content_params.json is already included
puffer.expected_header: time (ns GMT), format, channel, video_ts, size (read by position)

trace_preparation.fill_short_gaps: linear interpolation over gaps of at most max_gap_s seconds; longer gaps split the trace
